name: Mesh Remesher
author: Modly
description: Hole-safe remeshing: pre-cleans topology, feature-preserving isotropic remesh, then repairs and closes any pinholes. Quad mode is quad-dominant cleanup, not character retopology.

params_schema.label: Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Triangle produces a clean uniform triangulation. Quad-Dominant attempts more regular polygon flow for cleanup, but it is not character-oriented retopology. None passes the mesh through unchanged.

params_schema.label: Target Edge Length
params_schema.tooltip: Target edge length in world units. Set to 0 for automatic (keeps the input's sampling density, derived from surface area).

params_schema.label: Target Face Count
params_schema.tooltip: Desired total face count. When above 0, the remesh targets this count (exact when reducing; approximate when increasing). Set 0 to use Target Edge Length instead.

params_schema.label: Quality
params_schema.tooltip: Remeshing passes. Draft (3) is fast but leaves jagged triangles; Standard (6) suits previews; Fine (10) converges to the most even, precise triangulation.

params_schema.label: Preserve Features
params_schema.tooltip: Keep sharp edges (creases above 30°) crisp while remeshing. Turn off for organic meshes where every edge is smooth.

params_schema.label: Weld Distance
params_schema.tooltip: Vertices closer than this are merged before remeshing, sealing the hairline cracks GLB exports leave along UV seams — a major source of remesh holes. 0 = automatic (0.1% of the model's diagonal). Raise slightly if holes persist, lower if thin details melt.

params_schema.label: Fill Holes
params_schema.tooltip: Close small holes before remeshing and after every destructive pass, so the output stays watertight.

params_schema.label: Max Hole Size
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum number of boundary edges of a hole to be filled. Raise if holes remain open after remeshing.
